    if len(x_shape) == 4:  # 2D convolution
        batch_size, input_dim, h, w = x_shape
        _, output_dim, kh, kw = w_shape
        _, _, oh, ow = out_shape
        conv_dim = 2

        _, output_dim, kd, kh, kw = w_shape
        _, _, od, oh, ow = out_shape
        conv_dim = 3
    else:
        raise ValueError("Unsupported convolution dimension")
    
    # Calculate spatial size
    if transposed:
        # For transposed convolution, spatial size comes from output shape
